studio: Capture photos or import images, enhance selected pages, recognize text when needed, and create a PDF.
Use Camera for new photos. Import Images is for pictures already saved on your device.
Choose existing photos. The camera is a separate action; it is not in the import menu.
Select thumbnails to review page order, rotation and deletions before creating a PDF.
Use the blue enhancement actions to improve readability. Preview each change and reset if needed.
OCR recognizes text within scanned pictures; Find Text searches text that is already recognized or embedded.
Use page navigation to check every image, including the first and last page.
Select page size and orientation, then Create PDF. Continue with Edit in Sign or Edit in Tools.
Move the created PDF to Sign to add signatures, dates or text.
Move the created PDF to PDF Tools for further document changes.
tools: Choose one of six categories. Only the selected category displays its operations; tap the category again to collapse it.
Load the document you want to edit.
Add another document for merge or comparison operations.
Row 1: Markup and Text & Images. Row 2: Pages and Advanced. Row 3: Combine & Compare and Batch. Choose one category at a time.
Choose annotation, watermark, image watermark, header/footer, or form tools.
OCR and Invert appear first, followed by the other text and image operations. The buttons use equal sizes.
Choose Pages to reveal page operations. Switching to another category hides Pages options.
Choose Advanced for additional PDF operations.
Merge documents or compare two PDFs here.
Apply the selected operation, inspect the preview, and use the export actions. Undo, Redo and Remove are above export.
